GSE301119.limitation: CRISPRi and CRISPRa are separate strata and do NOT share a feature space, 36,601 against 19,162 genes; cross-modal scores require the actual feature intersection. The two modalities also target different gene sets: union 208, intersection 204. Cells are not donors. Two donors permit only limited transport inference. Both code paths use the same author/lane's estimand. The planted flat-gene raw-count control yields -0.807 normalized log2FC under other-gene changes, so numerical agreement does not validate the top downstream effects. PR125 two-arm matched NT versus NT null has CPU fixtures only; real physical result pending.
